title: A non-merchant buy-down fee debits FUND_SOURCE 5 5000 then credits DEFERRED_INCOME_LIABILITY 22 5000 (loan 20 L781)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the TWO-LEG journal entry a BUY_DOWN_FEE transaction posts on a NON-merchant buy-down product, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_PROGRESSIVE_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_BUYDOWN_FEES_NON_MERCHANT, merchantBuyDownFee false) at the buy-down-fee transaction L781. request.buy_down_fee_journal.amount transcribes the loan read-back's buyDownFee transaction id 781: amount 50.000000 -> "5000" minor units. request.buy_down_fee_journal.merchant is the read-back's top-level merchantBuyDownFee false, so the request leaves it unset (the zero value). request.buy_down_fee_journal.accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request create-request-LP2_PROGRESSIVE_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_BUYDOWN_FEES_NON_MERCHANT.json: fundSourceAccountId 5, deferredIncomeLiabilityAccountId 22, and NO buyDownExpenseAccountId (the non-merchant product carries none), so buy_down_expense is absent. The product's ONLY channel mapping is paymentTypeId 1 -> 17 and the buy-down fee was posted with paymentTypeId 5, which has no channel mapping, so the default FUND_SOURCE 5 applies -- exactly the account the observed debit names. expect.buy_down_fee_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L781 legs in id order from the journal-entries sweep: id 1634 entryType DEBIT glAccountId 5 amount 50.0 and id 1635 CREDIT glAccountId 22 amount 50.0. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: when the product's merchantBuyDownFee is NOT set the buy-down-fee debit posts to the resolved fund source, then the credit posts to deferred income liability. THIS NON-MERCHANT OBSERVATION IS THE CONTROL for the ignore-merchant drive: a port that always debits the fund source posts the SAME legs here, and it is the merchant sibling that moves the debit account. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: the merchant buy-down-expense debit (a sibling vector) and the buy-down-fee adjustment, amortization and amortization-adjustment postings (not observed, no input). Nothing was computed by this promotion: every amount, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
